game.title: Resident Evil Village
game.blurb: First-person survival horror set in a snowbound village and its castle, from Capcom, released 2021-05-07. RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The campaign and its big encounters, as hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Combat and Survival
chapters.summary: Guarding and pushing, sniping, fire, flaming arrows, crows, hunting animals and the Vârcolac Alfa.

chapters.title: Exploration and Treasures
chapters.summary: Lockpicks, treasures, Labyrinths, the village map, Goats of Warding, outhouses, castle windows, files and Lei.

chapters.title: The Duke, Crafting and Weapons
chapters.summary: Buying from the Duke, crafting items and recipes, and fitting customizable gun parts.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing the story on Casual, Standard, Hardcore and Village of Shadows, in under 3 hours, and on a budget.

chapters.title: The Mercenaries and Additional Orders
chapters.summary: Combos and S ranks in The Mercenaries, and the Bloody Village and Bloody River in Additional Orders.

chapters.title: Extras and Bonuses
chapters.summary: Photo Mode, character and weapon models, and concept art.

chapters.title: Shadows of Rose
chapters.summary: The Shadows of Rose story, on each difficulty, and its crafting.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Resident Evil Village" or "Resident Evil: Village" (RAWG's name). residentevil.fandom.com answers the API under "Resident Evil Village", with about 416 linked articles, mostly cast and crew; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1196590 is "Resident Evil Village". 15 of 56 Steam achievements are hidden. "It's Starting to Grow on Me" sits among the Shadows of Rose achievements and was put in that chapter, a guess from position. The other 14 (names such as "Four Lords", "Iron Giant Down" and "Knives Out") sit in the story chapter; a few, like "Goooaaal!" and "Timber", may be side feats. RAWG lists "Shadows of Rose" (2022-10-28) and "Winters' Expansion" (2022-10-27) as their own entries. The data does not say how Additional Orders relates to The Mercenaries, so the chapter names both.
